# Which hours is your labor cost running over target?

> Free tool for restaurant owners: drop in your hourly sales and time-entry exports and see labor % of sales and sales per labor hour by daypart, weekday and hour, plus the labor above your target you could trim without going under a minimum crew. Runs in your browser, files are never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
